classificationMeaning.A: 2-4 uncredited whole identities, one current accepted contract, mature primitive/production route, no shared runtime/initialization changes; write grant separate
classificationMeaning.B: Content admission prerequisite; primitive presence not registration
classificationMeaning.C: Identified semantic/runtime extension needed for the stated envelope, not a claim all family members need runtime
classificationMeaning.D: Missing evidence/full-clause scope/eligible multiplicity/rule proof; do not infer runtime gap

scopeLimit: 32 historical catalog entries mapped fail-closed plus two independently inspected narrow scopes; NOT exhaustive 833-identity runtime audit
